purpose: Audit city-scoped land/cadastre evidence separately from accessible public parcel geometry; record only executed searches and actual page/request outcomes.
name: Monrovia
pointBasis: Chosen approximate central-city query point; not a WUP centroid or official boundary.
jurisdiction: Liberia Land Authority administers national land registry and survey/mapping; Monrovia is within the relevant urban authority area.
registryBasis: City-specific evidence documents a Port of Monrovia resurvey procurement whose scope includes cadastral/parcel mapping. That is a bounded port-site survey, not evidence of a city-wide Monrovia parcel register. The Liberia Land Authority’s national mandate is context only; city-wide registry coverage was not established.
findings: An official 2026 procurement notice documents cadastral and parcel mapping in the Port of Monrovia, while the LLA states a national land-registry and cadastral mandate. The port survey is site-specific and does not establish a city-wide register. The LLA site was previously observed behind a bot-challenge interstitial in country-level evidence; no challenge was bypassed and that access barrier is not evidence of registry absence. No public Monrovia parcel polygon endpoint was verified.
